# Open Live Studio (`eyevinn-open-live-studio`)

Revolutionize your broadcasting with Open Live Studio, the ultimate browser-based production controller. Seamlessly integrate and manage broadcasts using cutting-edge tech for a flawless live experience.

[Source](https://github.com/Eyevinn/open-live-studio)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "eyevinn-open-live-studio"
  name       = "mystudio"

  parameters = {
    OpenLiveUrl = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    OscAccessToken = var.osc_access_token
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OpenLiveUrl` | string | yes | The URL of the open-live backend API that this production controller will connect to for managing sources and productions |
| `OscAccessToken` | string | no | Personal Access Token for Open Source Cloud (OSC) authentication and deployment operations Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
